pages.text: A set of NuclearCraft monitors by dyc3 and friends, from their MeatballCraft playthrough. Servers read a machine through an $(item)Adapter$(); clients show it from anywhere, over a Network or Linked Card.$(br2)Add the source once:$(br)$(l)oppm register dyc3/meatballcraft-infra$()

Then install what you need with $(l)oppm install <name>$():$(li)$(l)nc-dashboard$(): every service on one screen$(li)$(l)nc-reactor-server$() / $(l)nc-reactor-client$(): salt reactors, with remote control$(li)$(l)nc-reactor-relay$(): crosses dimensions by Linked Card

$(li)$(l)nc-heat-server$() / $(l)nc-heat-client$(): heat exchangers$(li)$(l)nc-turbine-server$() / $(l)nc-turbine-client$(): turbines$(li)$(l)nc-geiger-server$() / $(l)nc-geiger-client$(): radiation$(br2)Run a server once to name it, then $(l)rc nc-heat-server enable$() to start it at boot.
Full setup notes are in the repository under nuclearcraft/README.txt. Installs always fetch the latest version.
